state.encoding: chromosome: use cases then entities. Graph rows useCaseOperation=[uc index,op index], operationEntity=[uc index,op index,entity index]; integer i denotes stable uc:i/operation:i/entity:i. Nonstandard IDs remain strings. Every relation retained. Derive caller/provider and all remote edges from graph plus chromosome; checkSummary accounts for every checked edge, exceptions retain every failure/unknown. No remote edge list is needed twice. Summary is deterministic program evidence, not an LLM judgment. Missing checks mean unknown; remote access is legal; no behavior equivalence proof.

configuration.instructions: IFN is minimized; CHD, CMQ, Instability and UCM are maximized. All normalizedLoss values are lower-is-better. Here Instability is the all-service mean provided/(provided+required), isolated=0, not an external definition. Select one remaining candidate or KEEP using actual five-metric trade-offs and use-case/operation and operation/entity consistency evidence. Cross-service access is not automatically inconsistent. Do not invent behavior or require co-location. Equal consistency evidence is non-discriminative. Selection does not guarantee improvement or retention. Return the offered Choice only.
